description: This file defines the LandedCostVoucher class for handling landed cost vouchers in ERPNext, including methods for retrieving items from purchase receipts, validation, calculation of taxes and charges, and updating stock and asset information.

classes.name: LandedCostVoucher
classes.description: Represents a Landed Cost Voucher document with methods for managing landed costs, including item retrieval, validation, and stock/asset updates.

methods.name: get_items_from_purchase_receipts
methods.description: Fetches items from associated purchase receipts and adds them to the voucher.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks before saving or submitting the voucher.

methods.name: check_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures that purchase receipts are entered.

methods.name: validate_receipt_documents
methods.description: Validates the status and stock impact of purchase receipt documents.

methods.name: set_applicable_charges_on_item
methods.description: Distributes total taxes and charges across items based on configuration.

methods.name: validate_applicable_charges_for_item
methods.description: Validates that total applicable charges match total taxes and charges.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Triggers updates when the voucher is submitted.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles updates when the voucher is canceled.

methods.name: update_landed_cost
methods.description: Updates stock, assets, and valuation rates based on the voucher.

methods.name: validate_asset_qty_and_status
methods.description: Checks asset creation and linkage for fixed assets.

methods.name: update_rate_in_serial_no_for_non_asset_items
methods.description: Updates serial number purchase rates for non-asset items.
